fonts.description: Critical for the 'wireframe/terminal' aesthetic. Use for small labels, stat numbers, and navigation.

rules: Labels must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] with JetBrains Mono.
Every major section should be separated by a 1px border-slate-800/80.
Cards should not have massive drop shadows; rely on 1px borders and slight background shifts (bg-slate-950 to bg-slate-900) on hover.
Use Tetris Grid (asymmetric) for the 'Services' and 'Projects' sections.
Generous spacing: use p-8, p-12, or p-16 inside bordered containers to prevent text collision.

surfaces: Tracing Beam: Use a glowing border effect on the 'Leading AI Solutions Firm' badge.
Glassmorphism: Use ONLY for the sticky header (bg-slate-950/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-slate-800/80).
motion: Staggered fade-up for grid items in 'Projects' and 'Services'.
Hover states on cards: -translate-y-1, border-cyan-500/50, and text color shifts.

header.style: Sticky, Glassmorphism, z-50. Must include Logo, Nav links (JetBrains Mono text-sm), and 'Contact Us' CTA button.

hero.style: Left-aligned, highly structural. Badge with Sparkles icon. H1 text-5xl md:text-6xl+. 3-item stat bar placed inside a bordered sub-grid at the bottom of the hero.

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-medium rounded-none or rounded-sm. Sharp edges fit the wireframe aesthetic.
buttons.secondary: border border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-500 text-slate-100 bg-transparent rounded-none or rounded-sm.

cards.style: Flat background (bg-slate-950), 1px solid border-slate-800/80. No shadows. On hover, apply a subtle bg-slate-900 shift and border-cyan-500/30.

image_urls.instructions: Use with heavy opacity (opacity-20) and blend-mode-screen to add texture to the dark hero section without overpowering the text.
Place in the right column of the About split section. Overlay with a subtle border-slate-800/80 and grayscale until hover.
Use as a textured background for the contact section or alongside the embedded Google map to localize 'Nepal'.

media.icons: Lucide React (already specified in user choices). Use them generously in Services & Projects.

rules: All text must meet 4.5:1 contrast against bg-slate-950.
Input fields in contact form must have clear focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500).
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end structural wireframe landing page. Embrace sharp borders (border-slate-800/80) and raw grid aesthetics.
Do NOT center align text globally. Left-align text to maintain the blueprint/technical document feel.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Add Google Fonts links for 'Outfit' (headings), 'IBM Plex Sans' (body), and 'JetBrains Mono' (tags) to public/index.html.

Ensure the Google Map iframe is styled with CSS filters (e.g., 'invert(90%) hue-rotate(180deg) grayscale(1)') to match the dark theme, or just drop the opacity slightly so it doesn't break the dark UI.
Implement smooth scrolling for anchor tags (#about, #services, etc.).
Do NOT use pure black or pure white. Tint everything. Background is slate-950, borders are slate-800/80.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the 'Grid Borders' approach heavily: expose the skeleton of the layout.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
Use 2-3x more padding than usual (e.g., p-12, p-16) inside major sections.
